caveat: A 'matched' control means some assertion's NAME mentions its label as a word. It does NOT mean the control was pressed, nor pressed in every state. Matching is word-level against assertion names only (URLs and JSON details stripped), which under-reports rather than flatters -- but it still counts an assertion that merely mentions a word in passing. Treat this as an upper bound on coverage, not a measurement of it.
